name: IsQuantale.leftMulResiduation_le_iff_mul_le
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
x y z : α
inst✝² : Semigroup α
inst✝¹ : CompleteLattice α
inst✝ : IsQuantale α
⊢ Iff (LE.le x (IsQuantale.leftMulResiduation y z)) (LE.le (HMul.hMul x y) z)
decl:
@[to_additive]
theorem leftMulResiduation_le_iff_mul_le : x ≤ y ⇨ₗ z ↔ x * y ≤ z where
  mp h1 := by
    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_right' h1 _)
    simp_all only [leftMulResiduation, sSup_mul_distrib, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      iSup_le_iff, implies_true]
  mpr h1 := le_sSup h1
